I manage to find the solution with the help of an amazing person in the RPG Maker Discord.
For those who gets this issue, it's apparently one of those rare cases.
The problem was in the System.Json file.
On the Item Categories part, it was worded not in a way that the Data File wanted it to be written.
Here's the one that was in my Json file
Which is incorrect and caused the game to not read it properly for the Plugin to work.
And this is the correct way.
The person helping me at the time, we had to literally make a new project folder and just transfer everything i had from my original project one by one until we caught the error.
Im not sure how to close this thread, but I do thank you for trying to help me
